_help: One entry per domain. check = URLs fetched from this machine on every sync (plain GET with a browser user agent; avoid API URLs on apps with aggressive bot protection). gsc = Search Console property (sc-domain:… or https://…/). ga4 = 'properties/<id>' or a key from ga4-properties.json. cf_zone = Cloudflare zone name (needs CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN). server = free text: what serves it. dns_external_ok = A-record targets outside your servers that are expected. apps = App Store apps (Apple id).
